text: Prefer community routes steers routing onto shortcuts drawn by other riders; routes that use one say so. Confirm a community contribution exists. Open reports push routes onto the next street. Save places from the place card; saved places route in two taps. Route alternatives show how they differ in time, distance and climb. Record rides with the ● button, pause, resume, recover an interrupted recording, trim a stretch and share it. Copy a link to any trip.
